name: KARYON
recent: Karyon 于9月28日完成以861万令吉收购柔佛工厂，并于9月9日召开第23届常年股东大会，所有议案均获通过。公司同时宣派每股0.45仙的中期单层股息，除息日为9月10日，派发日为9月29日。
notable: 全资子公司 Hsing Lung Sdn Bhd 完成收购一块永久工业用地及一栋独立工厂，交易价861万令吉。
第23届常年股东大会于2026年9月9日举行，所有普通决议案均以100%赞成票通过。
宣派2027财年每股0.45仙中期单层股息，除息日9月10日，派发日9月29日。
risks: 主席 Loh Chen Yook 及董事 Loh Fatt Chong 在闭窗期内有买卖公司证券的意向。

news.title: Karyon completes RM8.61m Johor factory acquisition

recent_en: Karyon completed the RM8.61 million acquisition of a Johor factory on 28 September and held its 23rd AGM on 9 September, with all resolutions passed. The company also declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.45 sen per share, with ex-date on 10 September and payment on 29 September.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Hsing Lung Sdn Bhd completed the acquisition of a freehold industrial land with a detached factory for RM8.61 million.
The 23rd AGM was held on 9 September 2026, with all ordinary resolutions passed by 100% votes in favour.
Declared an interim single-tier dividend of 0.45 sen per share for FY2027, ex-date 10 September, payment date 29 September.
risks_en: Chairman Loh Chen Yook and Director Loh Fatt Chong have indicated intentions to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
